title: Crop Agnostic Monitoring Driven by Deep Learning
summary: A deep-learning instance-segmentation system estimated crop/weed species and sweet-pepper ripeness across field and greenhouse robot platforms. In greenhouse imagery, fruit counts had normalized absolute error 4.7% and R² 0.901 against visual ground truth; broader deployment outcomes were not tested.
